modmenu.summaryTranslation.dopes_seamles: Takes a screenshot when you leave a world or server and shows it again when you rejoin.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.dopes_sea: Takes a screenshot of the game when you leave a world or server, and displays it on the loading screen when you rejoin it. With slideshow backgrounds, loading tips, chunk counter and smooth fade animations.
dopes_seamless_loading_screen.config.gen: Enable or disable the entire mod.

Remember where you were when you left a server, and only show the screenshot again when you rejoin at (roughly) the same spot. If you end up somewhere else (a lobby, another world, ...) the slideshow is shown instead, so the screenshot is never misleading.
dopes_seamless_loading_screen.config.scr: Replace the vanilla loading screen text, chunk map and progress bar with the mod's own animated text, icon, progress bar and tips. Off = the vanilla loading screen is shown.
Show chunk loading progress at the top of the screen (loaded / total).
Show a short tip (a useful hint, a fun fact or a joke) in the top left corner of the loading screen, drawn in the bundled uni 05_53 pixel font.

Wait for all chunks to fully load before starting the fade animation. Only active while an actual screenshot is on screen: without one (or on a server that shows the slideshow instead), the screen closes as soon as the world is ready.
dopes_seamless_loading_screen.config.tra: Show the screenshot (or slideshow) over the transition when entering a world or server and when leaving them. The screen fades in, starts the load and stays on top until the loading screen appears (hiding the screens in between), then fades out. Its blur and dim are the same as on the loading screen, but static.
How long the auxiliary screen takes to appear and to disappear. The same for entering and leaving, before and after the world. 0 = no animation.
dopes_seamless_loading_screen.config.dis: How strongly the screenshot is blurred while the loading screen is up. 0 = no blur, higher = stronger (max 256). The blur is built in steps, so the animation looks smooth.

Percentage of darkening over the background image. 0 = no dim. It is always fully applied, it does not fade in. On strong settings the handover between the auxiliary and the main loading screen no longer darkens the picture twice.
How long the screenshot takes to fade out once the world is ready: the image disappears and the world shows through. 0 = instant.

How much of the fade animation the blur takes to disappear. 100% = the blur is gone exactly when the fade ends, 50% = twice as fast, 0% = no animation (the blur stays until the end of the fade). The slideshow never animates its blur: the blur stays until the end of the fade.
Resolution the screenshot is sampled at on the loading screen: 100% = as is, 50% = half. The picture is always scaled to the screen, a lower value only makes it softer.
dopes_seamless_loading_screen.config.tim: Keep the loading screen visible for at least this long so the screenshot can be seen. 0 = disabled.
Never keep the loading screen open longer than this, even if the chunks are still loading. 0 = no limit.
dopes_seamless_loading_screen.config.sli: Show a slideshow instead of a static background when the world has no screenshot yet.
How often slideshow images change. 0 = slideshow disabled (one random static image). A folder with a single file also disables slide switching.
Duration of the fade transition between slideshow images. 0 = instant switch.
Opens the folder where you can put your own PNG images for the slideshow.
dopes_seamless_loading_screen.tip.1: Creepers started as a failed pig model with the legs the wrong length.
dopes_seamless_loading_screen.tip.2: The first version of Minecraft was built in about a week.
dopes_seamless_loading_screen.tip.4: Pigs were among the very first mobs ever added to the game.
dopes_seamless_loading_screen.tip.5: Enderman sounds are real human voices, pitched down and played backwards.
dopes_seamless_loading_screen.tip.6: Lightning turns a creeper into a charged creeper - double the boom.
dopes_seamless_loading_screen.tip.7: Lightning turns villagers into witches and pigs into zombified piglins.
dopes_seamless_loading_screen.tip.8: Cats scare creepers away. Keep one around your base.
dopes_seamless_loading_screen.tip.9: Phantoms only hunt players who have not slept for three nights.
dopes_seamless_loading_screen.tip.10: Name a sheep jeb_ and its wool cycles through every color.
dopes_seamless_loading_screen.tip.11: Name any mob Dinnerbone and it turns upside down.
dopes_seamless_loading_screen.tip.12: The cake achievement is called 'The Lie' - a Portal reference.
dopes_seamless_loading_screen.tip.13: Chickens take no fall damage. They simply flap their wings.
dopes_seamless_loading_screen.tip.14: Snowballs actually deal damage to blazes. Pack some for the Nether.
dopes_seamless_loading_screen.tip.15: Obsidian is born where water meets a lava source.
dopes_seamless_loading_screen.tip.16: Diamonds are most common around Y -59, deep underground.
dopes_seamless_loading_screen.tip.17: TNT under water does not break a single block.
dopes_seamless_loading_screen.tip.18: The Ender Dragon egg teleports away when you punch it.
dopes_seamless_loading_screen.tip.19: Killing the Ender Dragon drops 12,000 XP - the biggest reward in the game.
dopes_seamless_loading_screen.tip.20: Beds explode in the Nether. That is not a bug, it is a warning.
dopes_seamless_loading_screen.tip.21: Milk removes every effect on you - even the useful ones.
dopes_seamless_loading_screen.tip.22: A fishing rod can reel in mobs, boats and even other players.
dopes_seamless_loading_screen.tip.23: Cactus destroys any item that is dropped onto it.
dopes_seamless_loading_screen.tip.24: Slimes spawn in swamps at night, most often under a full moon.
dopes_seamless_loading_screen.tip.25: Bees pollinate crops and make them grow faster. Be nice to bees.
dopes_seamless_loading_screen.tip.26: Axolotls play dead when hurt - and it actually saves them.
dopes_seamless_loading_screen.tip.27: The Warden is blind. It hunts purely by sound and vibration.
dopes_seamless_loading_screen.tip.28: Iron golems sometimes offer poppies to villager children.
dopes_seamless_loading_screen.tip.29: Glow squid ink makes sign text glow in the dark.
dopes_seamless_loading_screen.tip.30: Ancient debris never generates exposed to air - you have to dig for it.
dopes_seamless_loading_screen.tip.31: Minecraft is the best selling video game of all time.
dopes_seamless_loading_screen.tip.32: C418 composed most of the music. 'Sweden' is the most famous track.
dopes_seamless_loading_screen.tip.33: Alex, the second default skin, joined the game in 2014.
dopes_seamless_loading_screen.tip.34: A compass points to the world spawn, not to the nearest loot.
dopes_seamless_loading_screen.tip.35: Raids begin when a player with Bad Omen walks into a village.
dopes_seamless_loading_screen.tip.36: The sun and moon always rise in the east, just like at home.
dopes_seamless_loading_screen.tip.37: Zombies can break doors on Hard difficulty. Sleep with one eye open.
dopes_seamless_loading_screen.tip.38: A creeper killed by a skeleton's arrow drops a music disc.
dopes_seamless_loading_screen.tip.39: A baby zombie sometimes spawns riding a chicken. Yes, a chicken jockey.
dopes_seamless_loading_screen.tip.40: Take a deep breath - the world is almost ready.
dopes_seamless_loading_screen.tip.41: Silk Touch lets you collect certain blocks in their original form.
dopes_seamless_loading_screen.tip.42: Boats can travel very quickly on ice.
dopes_seamless_loading_screen.tip.43: In Java Edition, naming a rabbit `Toast` gives it a special texture.
dopes_seamless_loading_screen.tip.44: The Killer Bunny exists in Java Edition but is normally unavailable in regular gameplay.
dopes_seamless_loading_screen.tip.45: Before version 1.8, chainmail armor could be crafted using fire.
dopes_seamless_loading_screen.tip.46: The Far Lands were an unusual world-generation glitch in older versions.
dopes_seamless_loading_screen.tip.47: In Java Edition, holding F3+C for 10 seconds forces a game crash.
dopes_seamless_loading_screen.tip.48: A carved pumpkin can be placed on a mob's head.
dopes_seamless_loading_screen.tip.49: Creepers make no ordinary walking sounds.
dopes_seamless_loading_screen.tip.50: Pistons have a limit on how many blocks they can push.
